_comment: Settings for the Igniters youth quiz pipeline. Limits mirror Kahoot's editor limits; adjust if your Kahoot plan allows more.

_language_modes.combine_if_fits: Question = English + newline + Tamil when it fits the limit, otherwise English only (warned).
_language_modes.english_only: Always use the English text only.
_language_modes.tamil_only: Use the Tamil text when present, else English.
